title: reports/checks.json - the release record (docs/design.md 1.5's `release` row, section 2, "### M3.")
description: Written by engine/scripts/attest.py's build() (engine/scripts/check_release.py wraps it as the `release` gate). One entry per gate that applies to the block's skill, whether it ran, passed, or was waived.

attestation_sha256.description: sha256 of this document's own body (every field but this one), sorted-key JSON - attest.verify()'s tamper check.

tool.description: the gates.yaml row's own `tool` (the check_<tool>.py stem that ran, or `stub` for a gate not yet built) - null only when the gate has no gates.yaml row for this skill at all.

version.description: checklib.CHECKER_VERSION at attestation time - the checker SEMANTICS version every gate in this attestation shares, the same one a waiver binds against (attest.waiver_problems).

applies.description: always true here - a gate that does not apply is simply absent from the list (attest.applicable_gates), never a false entry.

reason.description: why a gate has no recorded result, or why `ok` is false - null/absent on an ok, ran check.

inputs.description: {artifact kind: normalized hash} this gate's last recorded pass read - the durability binding a waiver (attest.waiver_problems) checks against.

waived.description: true only when a durable waiver covers this otherwise-not-ok gate; absent or false otherwise.
